text: Aboard the RMS Aurelia, 11 April 1912. Dear Mam, We are four days out from port, and this ship is like a floating city, with more than two thousand people on board. I wish you could see it. Yesterday a little girl from first class dropped her ribbon over the rail, and it floated all the way down to our deck. I tied it in my hair.
